name: fructus
description: Fructus - a 16-bit retrocomputer: instruction set spec and toolchain

scripts.gen: mkdir -p build && node tools/gen-customasm.js > build/fructus.asm && node tools/gen-customasm.js --noat > build/fructus-noat.asm
scripts.rtl: mkdir -p rtl && node tools/gen-immgen.js > rtl/immgen.sv && node tools/gen-rhs.js > rtl/rhs.sv && node tools/gen-unary.js > rtl/unary.sv && echo "rtl/immgen.sv rtl/rhs.sv rtl/unary.sv"
scripts.binutils: node tools/gen-opcodes.js --header > vendor/binutils-gdb/include/opcode/fructus.h && node tools/gen-opcodes.js --table > vendor/binutils-gdb/opcodes/fructus-opc.c && node tools/gen-asm.js --header > vendor/binutils-gdb/include/opcode/fructus-asm.h && node tools/gen-asm.js --table > vendor/binutils-gdb/opcodes/fructus-asm.c && echo "vendor/binutils-gdb/{include/opcode/fructus{,-asm}.h,opcodes/fructus-{opc,asm}.c}"
scripts.map: mkdir -p build docs && node tools/gen-opcode-map.js > build/opcodes.html && node tools/gen-opcode-map.js --svg > docs/opcodes.svg && echo "build/opcodes.html docs/opcodes.svg"
scripts.map6502: mkdir -p build docs && node tools/gen-6502-map.js > build/6502.html && node tools/gen-6502-map.js --svg > docs/6502.svg && echo "build/6502.html docs/6502.svg"
